search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Official issuer sources were located for the business-line classification, listed products, and the explicit No. 1 statement. Stopped before the eight-turn cap; the ranking's underlying measurement basis remains undisclosed.

The worldwide No. 1 ranking is supported by Darfon's own undated English-language corporate page, but the page does not disclose the comparison set, measurement period, or ranking denominator/methodology.

Other issuer materials use different descriptions: the Chinese about page reports more than 30% global notebook-keyboard market share, while the 2023 investor presentation says global top three. These statements do not contradict No. 1, but they do not independently verify the rank.
